cases.name: taxi_pickup_time
cases.meaning: Meter-engagement local date/time, timezone-unspecified whole-second coordinate
cases.extraction: All source microsecond timestamps are whole seconds. Encode exact naive wall-clock seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00; no timezone inferred or UTC claim, rounding, modulo, clipping or offset subtraction. Sorting preserves datetime order; not a general uint32 microsecond timestamp API.

environment.toolchain: same LLVM-MinGW Clang23.1.5/libc++/UCRT, Boost1.90.0, C++20 O3 NDEBUG AVX2 BMI static pthread

scope: Only frozen B+D candidate vs released v0.1.2 and original competition implementations; no C/Cprime, diagnostics, tuning, exclusions based on performance, raw-record edits, GitHub edits or release.
measurement: Original fixed u32 buffer/common noinline templated function-pointer timer; CAFS i32 uses separate exact-value signed scratch; BD/competitor ABBA/BAAB, 4 blocks, pair order randomized, 3 fresh processes/input. Restore/load/conversion/warmups/full equality/route audits excluded; all sort-owned analysis/scans/alloc/init/sort/reconstruct/scatter/copy/free included.
eligibility: Original CAFS i32 exact nonnegative int32 representability and Counting dense uint64 counters within64MiB. Counting min/max and initialization inside timer; unsupported omitted with denominators.
